name: @absolutejs/dispatch
description: Provider-agnostic outbound message dispatcher for the AbsoluteJS ecosystem. Email / SMS / push behind one substrate-shaped factory; pluggable adapters live in @absolutejs/dispatch-adapters/*. Bundled memory + console adapters for tests + dev. Substrate pattern: metrics(), OTel via @absolutejs/telemetry, optional audit emission via @absolutejs/audit.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --sourcemap --target=bun --external @absolutejs/telemetry --external @absolutejs/audit && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.release: bun run format && bun run build && bun publish
